events.info: Enjoy a reception style meal from the comfort of the Tanger Center before select shows in the Koury Grandview Room on the third floor! Add your pre-show dining experience by adding it to your ticket purchase. You must have an accompanying show ticket to enter the reception. Please enter the Tanger Center at the Box Office entrance to access the Prelude Dining Experience. Prelude Dining opens 90 minutes prior to showtime. For sample menus and more information please visit www.TangerCenter.com/PreludeDining.
